caption: Noodles cook in a pot of boiling water, bobbing and swirling with the bubbles.

sa.check: A pot of boiling water sits on a hob.

pc.expect: The noodles move only as the churning water carries them, and they settle when the churn eases.
pc.fail: A noodle darts across the pot with the water still; or a noodle travels against the swirl; or the noodles swirl in water with no bubbles rising; or a noodle leaves the water and hangs above it.

pc.expect: The boil keeps up while the noodles turn: bubbles keep coming from below and steam keeps rising.
pc.fail: The bubbling stops and then starts again by itself; or the steam runs back into the pot; or bubbles sink from the surface downward; or the surface goes glassy still while bubbles stream below it.

pc.expect: The noodles are limp strands that bend and coil in the water and drape over each other, and the water closes round them.
pc.fail: The noodles stay straight and rigid like sticks while tumbling in the boil; or a noodle snaps into pieces that stay stiff; or the noodles fuse into one solid mass; or the water holds a dent around a noodle.

pc.expect: The noodles ride in the water, sinking or rising with the churn, and the bubbles and steam rise.
pc.fail: A noodle hangs motionless in mid-water while the rest churn; or a noodle rises out of the water and stays above it; or bubbles sink toward the pot's floor; or the steam sinks and pools around the pot.

pc.expect: The noodles keep their number and stay in the pot; nothing appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: A noodle vanishes; or new noodles appear with none added; or a noodle passes through the pot's wall; or two noodles merge into one thicker strand.

pc.expect: The pot, the hob and the water stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the water turns a colour; or the hob's knobs move by themselves.

note: The noodles softening as they cook is expected; how soft they get is not judged.
